desc: Derive the reformulation: absorb the k*i term into a fixed charge k*(totalCost - preC[l-1]) for each group start l>0, plus k*totalCost for the first group.
Implement the O(n^2) DP: dp[r+1] = min over l of dp[l] + preN[r]*(preC[r]-preC[l-1]) + (k*(totalCost-preC[l-1]) if l>0 else 0), returning dp[n] + k*totalCost.
Verify example 1 by hand (110) and confirm example 2 (985) plus edge cases (n=1, single group, all singletons).
Confirm integer bounds (Python big ints) and complexity O(n^2)/O(n) is fine for n<=1000.
